findings_and_disposition.discovery: WP08 self-review identified the race; independent WP09 review confirmed both consumers and suspended the earlier three-file W6 approval before publication.
findings_and_disposition.mechanism: Reuse reread an authenticated answer and its baseline outside C08, then protected only the source fence. A separately admitted human edit after the final external read could leave the source, immutable C05 and baseline unchanged while the old message body escaped as confirmed. Both generic and C05 Work branches had the corresponding gap and could return valid after the message changed.
findings_and_disposition.verified_fix: The common private helper pins the persistence object plus transactionAll/currentSnapshots method identities, preserves method receivers, clones expected identifiers/digests, and compares full canonical thread plus applicable exact or absent baseline in protected snapshots before and after the current producer fence. It checks method identity again after transaction completion. It performs no nested state read/write and creates no access grant.

baseline_cases.post_confirm: Exact thread and newly saved exact baseline.

findings_and_disposition.linearization: Successful reuse/work output is bound to the protected snapshot check. Source equality never replaces current source authorization; existing actual producer fences and ACL revalidation remain in place.

findings_and_disposition.finding: Both initial counterexample calls supplied two arguments to sfSourceIdentity. The existing producer requires snapshot, recordType and recordId.
findings_and_disposition.fix: Both calls now use sfSourceIdentity(snapshot, "projects", "project"). The physical identity assertion is preserved.

findings_and_disposition.verified_mechanism: Projects current confirmation issuer uses Portfolio Dashboard while the generic fixture originally issues All Projects. Page is part of the selector/scoped identity. Unconditional readHistorical could reintroduce the original scoped incarnation while prepare requires the current observation incarnation to equal scope.sourceRef.incarnation.
findings_and_disposition.correction: Generic scope again derives from message.sourceContext or the authenticated normal reader display. Existing exact source ref, selected fields, period, material dependency and manifest checks remain. Explicit C05 pins still require canonical threadMessageContext and full historical source authorization; C05 cannot fall through to current-domain confirmation.
findings_and_disposition.precision_note: The diagnosis is not that every fresh source requires a historical grant. historicalSources accepts a fresh source and readHistorical can fall back to canonical thread reading. No observedVersion is rewritten and no currentRef is fabricated.

other_reviewed_deltas.conclusion: C05 membership is a private identity predicate: current admitted context, raw canonical C08 thread, participation, latest recipient answer, exact full question/message/incarnation/version reference and matching installation/project are checked. It returns neither source data nor a grant. The normal authenticated answer reader still checks actual current source/recipient access and binds visible messages to a raw canonical thread digest. Non-C05 membership retains the full evidence producer.

Removing C05 resolve is limited to work already repeated by observe. The producer observe derives and compares the exact scope from actual C05 reads; C05 source/method/authority identities, all source and dependency fingerprints, physical incarnation, stored reread and current fence remain. R10 now adds protected stored thread/baseline equality to both branches.

The unit fixture currentSnapshots now exposes its existing actual model state at dashboard.data.__sfProductV1, instead of an empty object. All 23 earlier literal expect sites are unchanged. This remains a unit model; the SQLite counterexamples provide the integration evidence only if Actions passes.

counterexample_review.actual_setup: Each case creates an independent real SQLite fixture, C05 question and recipient answer, actual producer observation and explicit human confirmation through the real mutation API.
counterexample_review.interleaving: The wrapper awaits the real state read to complete, asserts that no protected snapshots remain active, then performs a separately admitted real threadHistory.edit and returns the previously captured read result. Reuse hooks the second baseline-only read; Work hooks its own second thread/answer/baseline read.
counterexample_review.consumer_selection: The real Work component is called directly, so a later collector reread cannot conceal an erroneous valid result.
counterexample_review.discriminating_oracles: The edit increments storage and message versions exactly once, preserves message ID/incarnation and sourceContext, and leaves saved baseline, actual project values, physical source identity, C05 review digest and actor/access digest unchanged. Thus the old source-only fence would remain satisfied. The raced read must be stale and raced Work unavailable without body/review disclosure; a fresh projection of the same real Work component must then report stale/answer-changed.
counterexample_review.limits: These counterexamples are prepared and reviewed, not executed locally. No runtime success or performance claim is made before the pinned Actions result.
